# UI visual fixtures

`music-player-latest-reference.png` is the 1402×108 DPR2 player crop from the
latest native Music screenshot supplied by Anson on 2026-08-23. The crop starts
at source pixel `(102, 36)` and is authoritative only for player chrome, glyph
geometry, scale, and colour; artwork and song copy are intentionally excluded
from visual comparisons.
